Nina usually has fish for breakfast. Nina is reading a book about science. It takes twenty minutes to get to the class meeting by bike. Be careful with the hot pan.
The class meeting is one of the best places in the city. Both of them like fish and milk. They took many photos at the club room. Best of all, let's catch up over dinner.

Nina plays chess with Grace every Wednesday. Nina thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. There are always many people at the club room. What's more, kids look up to their older cousins.
Nina wrote about the day in the diary. The weather was sunny that day. Nina learned a lot about science.
